method: Downloaded official sources; viewed actual JPG pixels and Poppler-rendered PDF page 2 at 1800px, not text-only inference.

sources.pixelInspection: Completed: two connected cars, broad blue front surround, dark observation windshield, silver side body, repeated paired side doors, exposed rail bogies and rooftop equipment.
sources.supportedUse: Visual type reference only; no source pixels used in texture, no mesh extraction.

sources.pixelInspection: Completed: actual train exterior photo and route/station illustrations on page 2. Text supports paired train layout, wider vehicles and cantilever seats without floor posts.
sources.supportedUse: Broad design and station relationship evidence; historical publication, not present operating timetable or surveyed vehicle drawing.

dimensionBasis.note: These are explicitly authored engineering targets, not dimensions measured from photographs or claimed exact manufacturer specifications. No Expo length, door spacing, floor or consist template was reused.

approximationList: Box-based low-poly shell and fascia rather than full Rotem surface reproduction
20 seats per reusable car for simplified gameplay; not a claim of official fleet seat count
Front observation glazing; no invented fixed driver cabin
Two car transforms with rear car yaw pi; static gangway only
Door transforms are authored plug+slide endpoints; not manufacturer kinematics
No branding textures copied from source photo
No materials claim physical laboratory calibration
